weeks.content:
Wash hands before eating
Chew with the mouth closed

Pick up my toys
Run small errands for mummy

Share the books
Water the class plant

Greet and listen when elders talk
Do not interrupt

Say my name to a new friend
Play together kindly

Hands are not for hitting
Use kind words only

Say my address with help
Say my school name

Who I can run to for help
Never follow strangers

Build one tower together
Clean up together

Act helping and kindness
Sing the good manners song
